snippet.title: Fool King - Announcement Trailer (New Strategy Autobattler)
snippet.description:
Dethrone the Fool King in this tactical autobattler with asynchronous PvP! Amass your troops, apply powerful upgrades and set your battle formations. Watch your plans come together or fall apart in frantic simulated combat. 

Developed by Loot Donkey and published by WuselFaktory, Firefly Studio’s new indie publishing label, Fool King launches later this year. 

Wishlist today and be the first to get your hands on the upcoming demo! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4380860/

Join other would-be Fool Kings in the LootDonkey Discord -  https://discord.com/invite/GngG8PfNw4

Find out more about WuselFaktory Publishing - http://wuselfaktory.com/
